items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: See this guy. His real name is Caruso. Charlie Caruso. Yeah. Remembered by his friends in the native city as Charlie Caruso.

ctx.x: I mean, it's been so long since I've heard it that I know of. You know, you must make a lot of stuff that you don't know.

Charles Anthony. Uh-huh. See this guy. His real name is Caruso. Charlie Caruso. Yeah. Remembered by his friends in the native city as Charlie Caruso. He's with this Methodopolitan. He didn't want to be the name of Caruso. So he changed the name to Charles Anthony. Speaking of changing names, we were talking about Wigs. Yeah. Where the hell did he get that? You know? He said he was from Churie. Johnny Wigs?
Yeah. I don't know. I really don't know. You know? This is a nice book to have here. Yeah. All the games and all the...
